title: EU to unlock 16 billion euros for Hungary as Magyar pushes ahead with post-Orban reforms
summary: The European Union will unlock more than €16 billion in frozen funds for Hungary, EU chief Ursula von der Leyen said Friday, praising what she described as "long overdue reforms" by newly elected Prime Minister Peter Magyar.
